title: Human-in-the-Loop: 5 Agents, 120 Reports, Zero Automation
text: For bias, and hand the decision to a human. 120 reports, 600 trace events, zero automated decisions. The gate is the point. The system organizes evidence, it does not act. title: Your Turn: Audit Your Own Thinking Today
text: My code. Write down the claim. Write down what would change your mind. Date your evidence. And when you cannot find a source, stop and say so. The strongest result here isn't a trading signal.
